text:
rachel_cs: Heads-up: Acme flagged as renewal-risk after pilot. Tokens ~20% over forecast and occasional p95 spikes ~420ms. They want a single-page "Kickstart Kit" we can send engineers + a short ops playbook we can flip if traffic spikes. Can we assemble and pick owners? @diego_cs @nisha_eng

diego_cs: I'll draft. Keep customer copy extremely short (3 bullets + quick examples). Ops playbook separate and internal.

nisha_eng: I'll add a tiny Node + cURL example. Recommend different quick wins than the usual doc: deterministic client cache, micro-batching with a 100ms hold, and streaming chunk-size tuning.

diego_cs: Draft customer-facing Kickstart Kit (one page):
- "Deterministic client cache — why: avoids re-sending repeated context across similar queries. Action: cache responses for 30-90s keyed by user_id + prompt_sha. Example header to include on requests:"
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
X-Cache-Key: user:{user_id}:prompt:{sha256(prompt)}
Cache-TTL: 60
```
- "Micro-batching at ingestion — why: batches reduce per-request overhead and lower unit cost. Action: hold up to 100ms to batch short requests into a single call. Suggested parameters: batch_max=16, hold_ms=100."
```js
// pseudocode (Node)
const aggregator = new BatchAggregator({ maxSize:16, holdMs:100 });
aggregator.on('flush', async (batch) => {
  const merged = mergePrompts(batch);
  const res = await fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(merged) });
  demultiplex(res, batch);
});
```
- "Streaming & chunking — why: smaller chunks make first-byte faster and reduce perceived latency. Action: enable streaming and set chunk_size to 256 tokens for long outputs; if latency spikes, temporarily reduce model size with a routing toggle."
```bash
# Example Console CLI to set fallback model route
redwood routes update acme-route --fallback-model "llama-7b-128q" --streaming-chunk-size 256
```

- "Quick customer ops steps (one-line actions):"
  1) Add X-Cache-Key header + TTL on requests.
  2) Enable batching in your backend SDK (hold 50-100ms, max 8-16).
  3) Turn on streaming for long responses and use chunk_size=256.
  4) If you see >5% errors or p95>500ms, request "Economy Mode" and we'll route to a cheaper model while we investigate.

nisha_eng: Internal runbook (ops) — short, actionable:
- Pre-check: collect 3 sample request IDs and the time window for the spike.
- Canary: create route acme-lowcost -> llama-7b-128q, start with 10% traffic. Command:
```bash
redwood routes create acme-lowcost --model llama-7b-128q --route-from acme-route --traffic-split 10
```
- Immediate relief steps (oncall):
  1) Increase canary to 100% if urgent and confirm with CS.
  2) Enable server-side prefix cache (Console toggle: "Enable prefix caching" for route).
  3) Apply per-customer concurrency cap: redwood quotas update --scope customer:acme --concurrency 5
- Rollback: revert traffic-split and disable prefix cache. Command to revert:
```bash
redwood routes update acme-route --traffic-split 100
redwood caches disable acme-route --prefix
```

tom_oncall: Monitoring & quick queries to check (Console metrics):
- p95 latency query: "latency[p95]{route=\"acme-route\"}"
- tokens/min: "sum(rate(tokens[1m])) by (route)"
- error rate: "rate(request_errors[5m])"
If you flip canary, watch tokens/min and p95 for 5 minutes and be ready to rollback.

ops-bot: Canary route "acme-lowcost" created — id=canary-2087 — status=ok

rachel_cs: Perfect. Owners: Diego = customer one-pager + send; Nisha = ops runbook + canary template; Tom = dashboard/watchlist; Rachel = client schedule & escalation. Diego, please paste a 1-paragraph cover note we can use in an email.

diego_cs: Cover note: "Hi Acme team — quick plan attached: three immediate engineering changes (client cache, micro-batching, streaming chunking) that typically improve latency and reduce token spend. We can also enable an ops fallback that routes traffic to a lighter model if you hit a spike. If you'd like, we can run a 30-minute calibration window with you this week to validate. — Diego, CS"

rachel_cs: Sending now. Adding 30-min calibration invite. Closing thread once sent and monitor for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
